claim_boundary: Research specification only; not a profitability, provider, challenge-purchase, payout, G0, pipeline, or live-trading approval.

hypotheses.statement: After the New York cash open, the first confirmed one-minute close outside the first five-minute range may carry enough intraday continuation to exceed micro-futures costs before the mandatory cash-session flat.

source_lineage.title: Can Day Trading Really Be Profitable?
source_lineage.source_scope: QQQ five-minute opening-range breakout; source does not establish an MES/MNQ futures port, mini-signal/micro-fill pairing, QM news exclusions, or the execution assumptions below.

source_lineage.use: Lineage and prior-selection disclosure only; no MT5 identity is carried into this futures lane.

qm_adaptations: Use individual CME equity-index futures contracts rather than QQQ or a CFD proxy.
Keep signal and executable fill instruments separately identified when a mini contract drives a micro fill.
Use side-correct micro MBP-1 quotes, fixed latency, explicit costs, a fail-closed news calendar, and a 15:55 New York flatten decision.
MES is examined before the MNQ transfer; this ordering is operational and does not allow selection on MES economics.
falsification: Primary MES/MES arm fails the locked validation rule under BASE or has non-positive net expectancy under ADVERSE.
The prospective untouched holdout is negative or inconclusive; an overlapping historical CFD period cannot substitute for it.
Results depend on a continuous/back-adjusted fill series, unverified roll, passive-touch fill, omitted no-signal sessions, or unbound costs.
Marked-equity loss breaches the preregistered daily or total research halt.

hypotheses.statement: A four-tick opening-range excursion that closes back inside the range within fifteen one-minute bars may mean-revert to the range midpoint before the cash-session flat.
hypotheses.structural_rationale: The test isolates short-lived opening price discovery failure; this is a QuantMechanica-authored conjecture, not a rule attributed to the ORB paper.
falsification: The single MES arm fails the locked validation rule under BASE or has non-positive net expectancy under ADVERSE.
Ambiguous two-sided excursions, data-invalid sessions, or no-signal sessions are dropped rather than reported.
The prospective untouched holdout is negative or has too few trades; insufficient observations are INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS.

SPEC_ORB_5M_CLOSE_BREAK_V1.long_trigger: First completed signal-instrument one-minute bar with close strictly above its own first-five-minute high.
SPEC_ORB_5M_CLOSE_BREAK_V1.short_trigger: First completed signal-instrument one-minute bar with close strictly below its own first-five-minute low.
SPEC_ORB_5M_CLOSE_BREAK_V1.entry_order: One marketable order on the fill micro at the first side-correct quote at or after signal-close timestamp plus scenario latency.
SPEC_ORB_5M_CLOSE_BREAK_V1.initial_stop: Opposite boundary of the fill micro's own first-five-minute range; mini signal prices are never used as executable micro stop prices.
SPEC_ORB_5M_CLOSE_BREAK_V1.early_exit: Exit when a completed fill-instrument one-minute close crosses the opposite opening-range boundary.
SPEC_ORB_5M_CLOSE_BREAK_V1.size_formula: floor((risk_fixed_usd - projected_round_turn_commission - projected_round_turn_slippage_usd) / stop_loss_usd_per_contract), capped at max_micro_contracts; fewer than one contract produces RISK_SKIP.
SPEC_ORB_5M_CLOSE_BREAK_V1.forced_flat: Submit a marketable flatten at 15:55:00 America/New_York; require flat confirmation by 15:59:30 or mark execution invalid.

SPEC_FAILED_BREAK_REVERSION_V1.long_trigger: Fill-instrument low reaches at least four ticks below its opening-range low and, within fifteen completed one-minute bars, a close is at least one tick back inside above that range low.
SPEC_FAILED_BREAK_REVERSION_V1.short_trigger: Fill-instrument high reaches at least four ticks above its opening-range high and, within fifteen completed one-minute bars, a close is at least one tick back inside below that range high.
SPEC_FAILED_BREAK_REVERSION_V1.entry_order: One marketable order at the first side-correct quote at or after confirmation-close timestamp plus scenario latency.
SPEC_FAILED_BREAK_REVERSION_V1.initial_stop: Two fill-instrument ticks beyond the excursion extreme observed through the confirming bar.
SPEC_FAILED_BREAK_REVERSION_V1.size_formula: Same fixed-risk formula as SPEC_ORB_5M_CLOSE_BREAK_V1; fewer than one contract produces RISK_SKIP.
SPEC_FAILED_BREAK_REVERSION_V1.forced_flat: Submit a marketable flatten at 15:55:00 America/New_York; require flat confirmation by 15:59:30 or mark execution invalid.

stage_policy.stage_1: Complete MES/ES/MES data-definition, calendar, event-order, quote, and fill-path checks before any MNQ import.
stage_policy.stage_2_release: Release MNQ/NQ imports only on technical data-quality PASS, never on MES economic performance.

periods.allowed_use: Implementation debugging and preregistered descriptive estimates only; no parameter search.
Apply fixed rules and fixed decision thresholds; disclose overlap with the source period through 2023.
Historical futures out-of-sample context only; never label as untouched market evidence because related CFD folds were viewed.
Single sealed evaluation after period completion; no peeking, interim statistics, parameter changes, or arm selection.

calendar.calendar_source_required: Dated official CME equity-index futures holiday/trading-hours artifact with SHA256; a floor-hours table or fixed UTC offset is insufficient.
calendar.dst_policy: Resolve each event through pinned IANA zones; never use Berlin time, broker time, or a fixed UTC offset.

contract_mapping.mapping_note: The deterministic calendar rule creates candidates, not facts. Before a run, licensed definitions/status data must verify each raw symbol, expiry, tick size, multiplier, first/last availability, and matching mini/micro expiry.

instrument_economics.verification: Every value must match the licensed point-in-time instrument definition before execution; mismatch is DATA_INVALID, not an override.

risk.halt_basis: Intraday marked-to-market equity including commissions and adverse fills; breach remains a failure after recovery.

execution.signal_data: Last-trade one-minute bars constructed from ordered raw events; retain exchange sequence and reject unresolved duplicate ordering.
execution.marketable_buy_fill: First executable micro ask at or after decision timestamp plus latency, then add adverse slippage ticks.
execution.marketable_sell_fill: First executable micro bid at or after decision timestamp plus latency, then subtract adverse slippage ticks.
execution.stop_gap_policy: Fill at the first executable side-correct micro quote after the stop trigger plus adverse slippage; never fill through missing data at the stop price.

scenarios.classification: Frozen research assumption from the current MFFU comparison, not a provider contract.
Mandatory severe stress; not a tunable arm.

news_blackout.session_policy: Skip the entire trading session when any blackout interval intersects 09:30:00-15:59:30 America/New_York, so a planned entry or exit is never placed in the restricted window.
news_blackout.protective_exit_policy: Protective exits are never disabled; whole-session exclusion prevents a planned exposure on known event days.
news_blackout.required_bundle: Dated, hash-bound historical and prospective news-calendar bundle covering every tested Chicago trade date.

no_signal_control.control_interpretation: NO_SIGNAL is zero exposure and zero P&L, retained in cadence and coverage denominators. It is not silently removed or converted to a counterfactual trade.

trial_ledger.rerun_policy: A rerun appends a new execution receipt linked to the same trial key and reason; it never overwrites, deletes, or silently replaces a screened result.

uncertainty.method: Stationary block bootstrap over Chicago trade dates
uncertainty.familywise_test: Holm correction across the two hypotheses at alpha 0.05

selection_constraints: Report all five arms and all three execution scenarios; do not choose the best arm after results.
A mini-signal transfer cannot rescue a failed micro-signal primary arm; it is a separately reported fixed comparison.
MNQ results cannot rescue MES or authorize a parameter change.
Historical context is never relabelled as the untouched holdout.
No challenge-purchase, payout, provider, or live decision follows directly from a backtest pass.

prior_cfd_evidence.interpretation: The source card has no completed positive Q04 verdict and confers no futures approval.
This is adverse selection history for an adjacent NQ-origin ORB port. Different futures data and fills do not erase it.

prior_cfd_evidence.artifact_availability: Referenced summaries are absent from the current report filesystem; stable database row IDs and card hash are retained without inventing metrics.
prior_cfd_evidence.interpretation: The individual-stock activity filter did not become established merely by porting it to index CFDs. It is not added as a sixth futures arm.
A 2026 MNQ falsification study reported that fourteen OHLCV signal families did not meet all cost-aware validation criteria; this lowers the prior and is not treated as support.

data_gaps.requirement: Licensed GLBX.MDP3 definitions, status, trades and MBP-1 for every used raw contract and period; no CFD, continuous, or official fixture substitute.
Verify the 132 candidate raw symbols against point-in-time definitions and materialize exact expiry/cutover mappings with hashes.
Dated official holiday and early-close calendar with a pinned content hash covering 2019-06-03 through 2027-03-31.
Complete hash-bound HIGH-impact USD event bundle for all tested dates, including the future prospective holdout.
Actual phase- and platform-specific commissions, exchange/routing charges, data fees, and order semantics; frozen research scenarios remain stresses, not contract facts.
Signal, order, stop, flatten, fee and timestamp parity on the later permitted native execution platform before any paid or live recommendation.
The untouched period must finish before 2027-04-01; interim economic access is prohibited.
